senses.gloss:
Doṣā, ‘evening,’ is frequently referred to from the Rigveda onwards, usually as contrasted with uṣas, ‘dawn.’ In the Chāndogya upaniṣad the word is contrasted with prātar, ‘early.’ See also ahan.
